blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration-fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder-decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF.
blocks.zh: 由于多模式传感器在成像观点和视场不匹配方面存在内在差异,现有的聚变方法长期以来一直在努力实现完全的场景级信息集成,超出了传感器视场的限制. 因此,产生的聚变结果往往含有特定模式的区域和聚变文物,限制了场景结构和语义信息的全面体现. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出了一个基因登记-储存框架,称为SeeRF。 具体地说,它首先引入了以二相平面平面平面速度场为基础的变形生成策略,结合了视觉地基模型-制导地物提取和粗糙到精细的渐进式多模式图像注册模块,以实现准确的跨模式流估计并生成有效的视野场口罩. 随后,注册模块与多模式完成和聚变的基因扩散模块紧密结合,其中跨模式控制编码模块和控制剩余特征编码器-解码器机制提供了有效的指导. 通过利用基因传播模型的强大前置模型能力,拟议框架克服了共享视野所施加的限制,并使得非重叠视野区域能够有效完成和自然地融合。 对多种公共数据集和现实世界情景的广泛实验表明,拟议方法取得了优异的性能,验证其有效性,优越性和稳健性. 该代码可在https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF上查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Image fusion is one of the fundamental problems in digital image processing [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Single-modal images are limited by their observation dimensions, resulting in insufficient information representation. In contrast, multi-modal images can integrate complementary information from different modalities through fusion to produce a more comprehensive representation of the scene. Therefore, it has wide applications in fields such as surveillance and security, autonomous driving, and industrial inspection [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 图像聚变是数字图像处理中的根本问题之一[1,2,3,4]. 单式图像因其观测维度而受限,导致信息表述不足. 相形之下,多模式图像可以通过聚变整合不同模式的补充信息,以产生更全面的场景表现. 因此,它广泛应用于监督和安全、自主驾驶和工业检查等领域[5、6、7、8]。

blocks.en: Infrared and visible image fusion represents a significant subfield of multi-modal image fusion. It seeks to integrate the rich textural details present in visible images with the thermal radiation characteristics captured by infrared imagery, thereby generating a unified and comprehensive scene representation. Nevertheless, the realization of such fusion fundamentally depends on the acquisition of data from both infrared and visible imaging sensors. Owing to inherent differences in sensor configurations and imaging viewpoints, existing methods characterize the problem by noting that source images acquired by multimodal sensors often exhibit substantial parallax [ 9 , 10 ] . Therefore, several studies have attempted to jointly address image registration and fusion [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] to mitigate these challenges. Despite these advances, most existing joint registration–fusion methods primarily focus on correcting spatial misalignment between cross-modal images while assuming that the source images have consistent field-of-view coverage. However, this assumption does not hold under most conditions. Consequently, existing methods must tolerate such field-of-view inconsistencies and often produce degraded fusion results with noticeable artifacts, while failing to preserve complementary cross-modal information across the entire field of view, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . This also compromises the semantic integrity of the fused representation, ultimately hindering the performance of downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 红外和可见图像聚变代表了多模式图像聚变的重要子领域. 它力求将可见图像中丰富的纹理细节与红外线图像所捕获的热辐射特性相融合,从而产生统一而全面的场景表现. 然而,这种聚变的实现从根本上取决于从红外和可见成像传感器获取数据。 由于传感器配置和成像角度的固有差异,现有方法对问题作了定性,指出由多式传感器获得的源图像往往呈现出巨大的平面[9、10]。 因此,一些研究试图联合处理图像登记和组合[11、12、13],以缓解这些挑战。 尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数现有的联合登记-合并方法主要侧重于纠正跨模式图像之间的空间错配,同时假设源图像有一致的视野覆盖。 然而,这一假设在多数情况下并不成立。 因此,如图1所示,现有方法必须容忍这种视场不一致的情况,并往往用显著的文物产生退化的聚变结果,同时未能在整个视场保存互补的跨模式信息。 这也损害了被保险的表述的语义完整性,最终会阻碍下游任务的执行.

blocks.en: On the basis of the above observations, considering differences in sensor installation positions, imaging geometry, and device intrinsic parameters, we rethink the challenges associated with data acquired by heterogeneous imaging sensors into two categories: viewpoint misalignment and field-of-view inconsistency. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , viewpoint misalignment introduces spatial displacements that disrupt spatial correspondences between cross-modal images, resulting in edge misalignment and ghosting artifacts. Meanwhile, the issues caused by field-of-view inconsistency become apparent as spatial misalignment is corrected and cross-modal alignment is established. Specifically, field-of-view inconsistency leads to non-overlapping regions and the absence of information from certain modalities, making it difficult for conventional fusion strategies to reliably integrate information in regions not covered by both sensors.
blocks.zh: 根据上述观察,考虑到传感器安装位置、成像几何学和装置内在参数的差异,我们重新思考与不同成像传感器获得的数据有关的挑战,将其分为两类:视线错配和视场不一致。 如图2所说明,观点错位引入了空间异位,干扰了跨模式图像之间的空间通信,导致边缘错位和幽灵文物. 同时,随着空间错位被纠正并确立跨模式对接,视野不一致所引发的问题变得明显. 具体而言,视场不一致导致区域不重叠,而且缺乏某些模式的信息,使得常规聚变战略难以可靠地整合两个传感器未覆盖区域的信息。

blocks.en: In this context, existing methods either fail to integrate information from the missing modality in regions outside the shared field of view, resulting in discontinuities between regions and inconsistencies in the distribution of fused information, or directly reduce the image coverage through center cropping, discarding field-of-view regions with degraded fusion quality and thereby producing fusion results with limited spatial coverage. This unresolved issue continues to hinder the full exploitation of the complementary information available in unregistered multimodal images for a long time.
blocks.zh: 在这方面,现有方法要么未能将共享视野以外区域缺失模式的信息整合起来,导致区域之间不连续,并造成引信信息分布不一致,要么通过中心收割、丢弃聚变质量退化的视野区域来直接缩小图像覆盖范围,从而产生空间覆盖面有限的聚变结果。 这一未决问题继续长期妨碍充分利用未登记的多式图像中提供的补充信息。

blocks.en: To this end, we propose a unified framework for generative image registration and fusion that learns to see information beyond the shared field of view, termed SeeRF. In detail, we first develop a stationary-velocity-field driven multi-modal image registration module (MIR). It synthesizes an invertible deformation field and jointly incorporates a fine-tuned feature extractor and matcher, enabling progressive estimation of the flow field and achieving view alignment. Subsequently, we develop a generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion (MCF). By performing cross-modal guided completion and fusion, the model establishes consistent observations in missing-scene regions and thereby achieves field-of-view alignment. Importantly, MIR and MCF are intrinsically coupled, jointly breaking the limitations of image fusion beyond the fields of view. MIR establishes a geometrically consistent coordinate system and provides registration-confidence masks, thereby laying the foundation for MCF-guided generation. Conversely, MCF exploits its powerful generative and completion capabilities to compensate for the missing correspondences encountered by MIR in absent or non-overlapping regions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses image fusion beyond the field of view perspective, achieving superior performance and robustness across multiple datasets.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议建立一个统一框架,用于基因图象登记和聚变,学习如何在共同视野之外看到信息,称为SeeRF。 详细来说,我们首先开发一个固定-速度-场驱动多式图像登记模块。 它合成了不可逆变形场,并联合装入了精细的特征提取器和匹配器,可以对流场进行渐进估计并实现取景对接. 随后,我们开发了多模式完成和聚变的基因传播模块。 该模式通过进行跨模式的制导完成和聚变,在失地地区建立了一致的观测,从而实现了视野的一致. 重要的是,MIR和MCF是内在结合的,共同打破了超越视野的图像融合的局限性. MIR建立几何一致的坐标系统并提供注册-自信口罩,从而为MCF导出打下基础. 反之,MCF利用其强大的基因和完成能力来补偿MIR在缺席或非重叠地区所遇到缺失的函文. 广泛的实验结果表明,拟议方法有效地解决了视野领域以外的图像融合问题,实现了优异的性能和跨越多个数据集的强健性.

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions can be summarized as follows: - From the perspective of multimodal sensor imaging, we propose a unified image fusion framework that jointly addresses spatial misalignment and field-of-view inconsistency. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first image fusion framework to explicitly explore and address the challenges of field-of-view discrepancies. - We propose a diffeomorphic stationary velocity field deformation generation strategy, which introduces the feature representation capability guided by foundation models and combines it with a coarse-to-fine progressive flow field regression mechanism to achieve high-precision cross-modal deformation modeling and flow field estimation. - By fully exploiting the powerful capability of generative diffusion models and combining it with the valid field-of-view mask and the collaborative effect of the registration module, we achieve effective generative completion and fusion of missing information outside the field of view, enabling the model to fully explore and utilize complementary information beyond the shared field of view across sensors. - Extensive experimental results demonstrate that SeeRF achieves excellent performance in both cross-modal image registration and fusion tasks, and effectively improves the performance of downstream semantic tasks.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Classical Image Fusion Methods
blocks.zh: II-A 经典图像融合方法

blocks.en: Early image fusion methods typically relied on hand-crafted fusion strategies, resulting in inherent limitations in both fusion effectiveness and generalization capability. With the development of deep learning, image fusion has achieved substantial advances in both methodological frameworks and technical capabilities. Initially, the autoencoder-based image fusion methods were proposed to achieve feature-level fusion by using encoders and decoders pretrained on large-scale datasets, together with hand-crafted fusion rules [ 14 , 15 ] . To overcome the limitations of hand-crafted fusion rules, end-to-end optimization-driven CNN-based methods were subsequently introduced [ 16 ] . These methods optimize similarity-based objectives with respect to the source images, thereby enabling effective integration of complementary source information. Recent architectural advances have provided new impetus for image fusion, leading to the emergence of Transformer-based [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , diffusion-based [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] , and lookup-table-based methods [ 23 ] that aim to improve fusion quality, model expressiveness, or efficiency. Meanwhile, considerable progress has been achieved in coupling image fusion with its upstream and downstream tasks [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] , ranging from prerequisite image registration to subsequent high-level vision applications.
blocks.zh: 早期的影像聚变方法通常依赖于手工制作的聚变策略,导致聚变有效性和通化能力的固有局限性. 随着深入学习的发展,图像融合在方法框架和技术能力两方面都取得了实质性进展。 最初,提出了基于自编码器的图像聚变方法,以通过使用在大型数据集上预先训练的编码器和解码器,以及手制的聚变规则[14,15]来达到特征级聚变. 为了克服手工化聚变规则的局限性,后来引入了以CNN为基础的端到端优化驱动方法 [16]. 这些方法优化了基于源图像的相似性目标,从而能够有效地整合补充源信息。 最近的建筑进步为图像融合提供了新的动力,导致出现了以变形器为基础的[17,18,19],以传播为基础的[20,21,22],以及以望表为基础的方法[23],这些方法旨在提高聚变的质量,模型表现力,或效率. 同时,在将图像组合与其上游和下游任务[24、25、26],从图像登记到随后的高级别图像应用,都取得了相当大的进展。

blocks.en: II-B Image Registration and Fusion Methods
blocks.zh: II-B 图像登记和组合方法

blocks.en: To mitigate image misregistration arising from intrinsic discrepancies in multi-modal imaging systems, such as variations in acquisition positions, integrated registration-and-fusion methods have been proposed. RFNet [ 9 ] integrates style transfer with a stage-wise registration and fusion framework to progressively compensate for parallax-induced spatial misalignment and produce geometrically aligned fused images. Also, UMF-CMGR [ 27 ] couples GAN-based cross-modal translation with a multi-level registration and fusion mechanism to facilitate reliable correspondence estimation between initially misaligned multi-modal images. Subsequently, C2RF [ 28 ] leverages commonality mining and contrastive learning to achieve image decomposition and fusion, while also adapting to subtle geometric deformations. Furthermore, MulFS-CAP [ 12 ] introduces a learnable modality dictionary and exploits a correlation matrix to jointly perform image registration and fusion in an end-to-end unified framework. FusionRegister [ 29 ] follows a strategy that first performs image fusion and subsequently refines severely misaligned regions via targeted correspondence correction, leading to enhanced fusion performance. Despite considerable progress in registration-based image fusion, existing methods remain unable to resolve field-of-view inconsistencies. It further leads to bottlenecks in both visual appearance and semantic information during fusion, thereby limiting the practical applicability of existing methods.
blocks.zh: 为了减少由于多式联运成像系统内在差异,如购置位置的变化而导致的图像登记错误,提出了综合登记和合并方法。 RFNet [9] 将风格转移与相相相相接的注册和聚变框架相融合,以逐步补偿由parallax引起的空间错配,并生成几何对齐的被保险的图像. 另外,UMF-CMGR[27]情侣基于GAN的跨模式翻译具有多层次的注册和聚变机制,以便于对最初错配的多模式图像进行可靠的对应估计. 随后,C2RF [28]利用共性挖掘和对比性学习来实现图像分解和聚变,同时也适应了微妙的几何变形. 此外,MulFS-CAP[12]引入了可学习的模式词典并利用了关联矩阵,在一端到一端的统一框架内联合进行图像注册和集成. FusionRegister[29]遵循的战略是,首先进行图像聚变,然后通过有针对性的函证校正来细化严重错配的区域,从而提升聚变性能. 尽管在基于注册的图像组合方面取得了相当大的进展,但现有方法仍然无法解决视野不一致的问题。 进一步导致在聚变过程中视觉外观和语义信息出现瓶颈,从而限制了现有方法的实际适用性.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we first clarify the problem formulation. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , we next detail the proposed framework, which comprises a multi-modal image registration module and a generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, along with diffeomorphic deformation generation strategy. Finally, we specify the loss functions used to optimize SeeRF.

blocks.en: The generative diffusion module aims to address field-of-view inconsistency, which arises from factors such as sensor characteristics and relative sensor configurations. It is tightly coupled with MIR through the registered source image and the validity field-of-view mask, and achieves field-of-view unification and fusion using a diffusion model with both generative and fusion capabilities.

blocks.en: We adopt a customized multi-modal latent diffusion model based on the Markov chain formulation of diffusion models [ 30 ] . By designing both the forward and reverse diffusion processes, image fusion is achieved. First, the pre-aligned source images with a complete field of view I i ​ r f ​ u ​ l ​ l , I v ​ i ​ s f ​ u ​ l ​ l I_{ir}^{full},I_{vis}^{full} is passed through an existing pretrained fusion network θ f t ​ e ​ a ​ c ​ h ​ e ​ r \theta_{f}^{teacher} to obtain a full-field fused image: I f f ​ u ​ l ​ l = θ f t ​ e ​ a ​ c ​ h ​ e ​ r ​ ( I i ​ r f ​ u ​ l ​ l , I v ​ i ​ s f ​ u ​ l ​ l ) , I_{f}^{full}=\theta_{f}^{teacher}(I_{ir}^{full},I_{vis}^{full}), (21) where I f f ​ u ​ l ​ l I_{f}^{full} is the full-field fused image. The proposed method facilitates prior knowledge transfer through distillation and integration, enabling the generation of complete fusion images covering the entire field of view, as shown in Fig. 5 . In detail, it is encoded using a VAE z 0 = ℰ f ​ u ​ l ​ l ​ ( I f f ​ u ​ l ​ l ) z_{0}=\mathcal{E}_{full}(I_{f}^{full}) , and the forward diffusion process is formulated as: q ⁡ ( z t | z 0 ) = 𝒩 ⁡ ( z t , α ¯ t ​ z 0 , ( 1 − α ¯ t ) ​ 𝐈 ) , q(z_{t}|z_{0})=\mathcal{N}(z_{t};\sqrt{\overline{\alpha}_{t}}z_{0},(1-\overline{\alpha}_{t})\mathbf{I}), (22) where α ¯ t = ∏ i = 0 t α i , α t = 1 − β t \overline{\alpha}_{t}=\prod_{i=0}^{t}\alpha_{i},\alpha_{t}=1-\beta_{t} , which follows the scheduler of simple diffusion model. blocks.en: To effectively optimize the network, we construct the image registration loss and the image fusion loss. The image registration loss is applied to the multi-modal image registration module and is enforced through flow-based constraints. The image fusion loss is applied to the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, and is supervised via the noise prediction and output consistency of the diffusion model.

IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: In this section, we first present the implementation details and the corresponding task settings. We then conduct comprehensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations to validate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method. Finally, we perform ablation studies to demonstrate the contribution of each individual module.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先介绍执行细节和相应的任务设置。 然后,我们进行全面的定性和定量评价,以验证拟议方法的有效性和优越性。 最后,我们进行消化研究,以展示每个单元的贡献。

blocks.en: Implementation Details: We implement the SeeRF with the PyTorch [ 32 ] in the machine with four NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs. The optimizer is AdamW [ 33 ] with a learning rate of 0.0001. For the image registration task, the batch size is 8 and the number of epochs is 800. For the image fusion task, gradient accumulation is used with an effective batch size of 16, and the number of epochs is 400. For the image registration task, we use a patch size of 520 × \times 520, while for the image fusion task, the original image resolution is used.
blocks.zh: 执行细节: 我们用PyTorch[32]在机器中用4个NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU执行SeeRF. 优化器为AdamW [33],学习率为0.0001. 对于图像注册任务,批量大小为8个,纪元为800个. 对于图像聚变任务,使用梯度堆积,有效批量大小为16个,而纪元为400个. 对于图像注册任务,我们使用520×\times 520的补丁大小,而对于图像聚合任务,则使用原始图像分辨率.

blocks.en: Datasets: To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct extensive experiments on widely used infrared and visible image fusion datasets, including MFNet [ 34 ] , FMB [ 35 ] , and LLVIP [ 36 ] datasets. For the MFNet dataset, we utilize 784 infrared–visible image pairs for training and 393 pairs for testing and evaluation. For the FMB dataset, 1220 image pairs are used for training, while 280 pairs are reserved for testing. Similarly, for the LLVIP dataset, we employ 1973 image pairs for training and 432 pairs for testing. For deformation generation, we synthesize geometric transformations using homographic transformations and elastic deformations. Specifically, the rotation angle of the homographic transformation is sampled from [ − 4 ∘ , 4 ∘ ] [-4^{\circ},4^{\circ}] , while the horizontal and vertical translations are constrained to 8% of the image width and height, respectively. For an image of size of 640 × 480 640\times 480 , these constraints correspond to maximum displacements of approximately 51 pixels horizontally and 38 pixels vertically. For elastic deformation, the displacement components along both the horizontal and vertical directions are bounded by 5 pixels. Additionally, we conduct experiments on real-world datasets to demonstrate the practicality of the proposed method. Through experiments on relatively comprehensive datasets, the performance of the method can be effectively verified.
blocks.zh: 数据集 : 为了验证拟议方法的有效性,我们对广泛使用的红外线和可见图像聚变数据集进行了广泛的试验,包括最惠国[34]、FMB[35]和LLVIP[36]数据集。 对于最惠国数据集,我们利用784个红外-可见图像对进行训练,393对用于测试和评价。 对于FMB数据集,1220个图像对用于训练,而280对则保留用于测试. 同样,对于LLVIP数据集,我们使用1973年的图像对来进行培训,432对用于测试. 对于变形生成,我们利用同位素变形和弹性变形合成几何变形. 具体地说,相位变换的自转角度分别取自 [− 4 , 4∘] [-4^{\crc}, 4^{\crc}] ,而横向和纵向翻译则分别被限制在图像宽度和高度的8%. 对于尺寸为640×480 640\times 480的图像,这些约束相当于水平上大约51像素和垂直上38像素的最大相去. 对于弹性变形,沿横向和纵向方向的移位元件以5像素相接. 此外,我们还对现实世界的数据集进行实验,以证明拟议方法的实用性。 通过对相对全面的数据集的实验,可以有效验证该方法的性能.

blocks.en: Metric: We adopt a comprehensive set of evaluation metrics to thoroughly assess the performance of both registration and fusion. For the cross-modal image registration, we employ the end-point error (EPE) [ 37 ] metric to evaluate the accuracy of the estimated flow correspondence, which directly measures the displacement error between the predicted and ground-truth flow fields. Additionally, mean absolute error (MAE), mutual information (MI) [ 38 ] , correlation coefficient (CC) [ 39 ] , and structural similarity index (SSIM) [ 40 ] are used to evaluate the quality of the registered images by comparing them with the ground-truth images. Among these metrics, lower EPE and MAE values indicate better registration accuracy, whereas higher MI, CC, and SSIM values correspond to more precise image alignment. For the image fusion, we employ standard deviation (SD), visual information fidelity (VIF) [ 41 ] , correlation coefficient (CC), edge information preservation metric Q A ​ B / F Q^{AB/F} [ 42 ] , and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) metrics to evaluate the quality of the fused images. Note that all metrics are evaluated using the full-field-of-view source images that cover the entire scene. SD, VIF, CC, Q A ​ B / F Q^{AB/F} , and SSIM are all metrics where larger values indicate better fused image quality.
blocks.zh: 度量 : 我们采用一套全面的评价衡量标准,彻底评估登记和核聚变的绩效。 对于跨模式图像登记,我们使用端点出错(EPE)[37]公尺来评价估计流量对应的准确性,该公尺直接测量了所预测的和地-地-地-地-地-地-地流域之间的转移错误. 此外,使用平均绝对错误(MAE)、相互信息(MI)[38]、关联系数(CC)[39]和结构相似性指数(SSIM)[40],通过比较地面真实图像来评价已登记图像的质量。 在这些度量衡中,低的EPE和MAE值表明登记准确性较高,而高的MI、CC和SSIM值则对应更精确的图像对接。 对于图像聚变,我们采用标准偏差(SD),视觉信息忠诚度(VIF)[41],关联系数(CC),边缘信息保存度量衡Q A B / F QQAB/F}[42],以及结构相似度指数度量(SSIM)度量来评价被熔化图像的质量. 请注意,所有度量衡都使用覆盖整个场景的全景源图像来评价. SD,VIF,CC,Q A B / F QQAB/F}和SSIM都是标尺,其中较大的数值表明有更好的接合图像质量.

blocks.en: SOTA Competitors: To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct systematic experiments on multiple public datasets and compare it with existing state-of-the-art approaches. For the image registration task, we select several representative methods as baselines, including RIFT [ 43 ] , GLUNet [ 44 ] , and CrossRAFT [ 45 ] . For the image fusion task, we compare our method against U2Fusion [ 16 ] and DDFM [ 21 ] . Furthermore, to comprehensively evaluate the performance of the proposed framework in joint image registration and fusion, we include a broader range of representative and advanced methods for comparison, including UMF-CMGR [ 27 ] , MURF [ 10 ] , SuperFusion [ 24 ] , AUNet [ 11 ] , MulFS-CAP [ 12 ] , and CPMFusion [ 46 ] .
blocks.zh: 事实 竞争者 : 为了验证拟议方法的有效性,我们对多种公共数据集进行系统实验,并把它同现有最新方法进行比较。 对于图像登记任务,我们选择了几种代表性方法作为基线,包括RIFT[43]、GLUNet[44]和CrossRAFT[45]。 对于图像聚变任务,我们比较我们的方法与U2Fusion[16]和DDFM[21]. 此外,为了全面评价拟议框架在联合图像登记和组合方面的绩效,我们列入了更广泛的代表性先进比较方法,包括UMF-CMGR[27]、MURF[10]、SuperFusion[24]、AUNet[11]、MulFS-CAP[12]和CPMFusion[46]。

blocks.en: Qualitative Results on Image Registration: To provide a more comprehensive evaluation of image registration performance, we visualize the gradient features of the visible images and overlay them onto the registered infrared images for qualitative analysis. The registration quality is assessed from two perspectives: first, the structural similarity between the registered infrared images and the ground-truth infrared images; second, the spatial consistency between salient infrared edges and visible-image gradient responses. A registration method is considered more accurate when the registered results preserve higher structural and detailed consistency with the ground truth while exhibiting stronger spatial correspondence between infrared edge regions and visible gradients, indicating more precise cross-modal spatial alignment. The visualization results are presented in Fig. 6 . In the first scene, benefiting from the effective cross-modal registration design, SeeRF accurately aligns the human targets and road edge structures, demonstrating superior registration performance. In contrast, existing competing methods suffer from varying degrees of registration errors, leading to noticeable misalignment in target regions. Such discrepancies are particularly evident in critical structural areas, including human contours and road boundaries, where substantial spatial deviations can be observed. Similarly, in the second and third groups of scenes, CrossRAFT demonstrates relatively strong registration performance in salient regions, including street lamps, vegetation, and vehicles, and is able to establish relatively accurate structural correspondences. However, due to its limited capability in handling complex scenes and boundary regions, its results still exhibit noticeable edge mismatches and local geometric distortions. Constrained by their registration capabilities, UMF-CMGR, MulFS-CAP, and CPMFusion fail to achieve effective alignment in these critical regions, resulting in considerable spatial discrepancies. Although SuperFusion and AUNet can capture certain cross-modal structural consistencies, they still suffer from local misalignment, indicating that their registration accuracy remains suboptimal. In comparison, the proposed method achieves the best performance in both fine-grained object alignment and global spatial consistency. In the fourth scene, CrossRAFT, SuperFusion, and AUNet achieve relatively accurate alignment in the stone pillar regions; however, their spatial correction capability for pedestrian targets remains limited, leading to noticeable deformation and structural distortion in these regions. In contrast, UMF-CMGR, MulFS-CAP, and CPMFusion fail to establish effective cross-modal spatial alignment, resulting in significant registration errors. Benefiting from the proposed registration strategy, SeeRF simultaneously preserves fine-grained object details and global scene structures, achieving superior overall registration performance in these scenarios.
blocks.zh: 图像注册的质量结果 : 为了对图像登记性能进行更全面的评价,我们可视化可见图像的梯度特征,并把它们覆盖到已登记的红外图像上,以便进行定性分析。 登记质量从两个角度进行评估:第一,已登记的红外线图像与地-真实红外线图像的结构相似性;第二,显著红外线边缘与可见图像梯度反应之间的空间一致性. 如果登记结果在结构上和细节上与地面真理保持一致,同时显示红外边缘区域和可见梯度之间的空间对应性更强,表明更精确的跨模式空间对接,则认为登记方法更为准确。 图6列出了可视化结果。 在第一个场景中,从有效的跨模式登记设计中受益,SeeRF准确调整了人的目标和路边结构,显示了优异的登记表现. 相比之下,现有的相互竞争的方法有不同程度的登记错误,导致目标区域明显不一致。 这种差异在关键结构领域特别明显,包括人文轮廓和道路边界,可观察到巨大的空间偏差。 同样,在第二和第三组场景中,CrossRAFT在包括街灯、植被和车辆在内的突出区域表现出相对强大的注册表现,并能够建立相对准确的结构对应。 然而,由于处理复杂场景和边界地区的能力有限,其结果仍然显示出明显的边缘不匹配和局部几何扭曲。 受注册能力所限制,UMF-CMGR、MulFS-CAP和CPMFusion未能在这些关键区域实现有效的对接,造成相当大的空间差异。 虽然SuperFusion和AUNet可以捕捉到某些跨模式结构成分,但它们仍然受到局部错位的影响,表明它们的注册精度仍然不尽人意. 相较之下,所拟议的方法在细纹对象对接和全球空间一致性两方面都取得了最佳性能. 在第四幕中,CrossRAFT,SuperFusion,和AUNet在石柱区实现相对准确的对接;然而,他们对行人目标的空间校正能力仍然有限,导致这些地区明显变形和结构扭曲. 相形之下,UMF-CMGR,MulFS-CAP,和CPMFusion未能建立有效的跨模式空间对接,导致重大登记出错. 从拟议的登记战略中受益,SeeRF同时保留了精细的物体细节和全球场景结构,在这些场景中实现了优异的整体登记性能.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results on Image Fusion: The corresponding qualitative visualization results are presented in Fig. 7 . Our method exhibits two significant advantages. First, SeeRF is able to generate more complete and natural fused scenes. Owing to the field-of-view discrepancy between infrared and visible sensors, certain target regions in the registered images may appear in only one modality, which causes existing methods to suffer from information loss, structural discontinuities, and unnatural visual transitions during the fusion process. For instance, in the first scene, part of the infrared information of the pedestrian within the purple box is missing. As most competing methods lack effective generative completion capability, they tend to produce obvious one-sided missing artifacts. Similarly, in non-overlapping field-of-view regions involving structures such as vehicle exhaust pipes, tires, road surfaces, handlebars, and feet, existing methods struggle to adequately model cross-modal field-of-view relationships, often resulting in structural omissions and fusion artifacts. In contrast, by combining an accurate cross-modal registration strategy with a diffusion-based generative fusion mechanism, SeeRF can effectively learn and recover information from non-overlapping field-of-view regions. As a result, it restores more complete target structures while maintaining spatial consistency, thereby producing fused results that are more natural, continuous, and visually coherent. Second, SeeRF can generate clearer visual representations while effectively preserving key structures and detailed information from the source images. In the fence region of the first scene and the high-voltage transmission tower region of the third scene, most comparison methods fail to sufficiently preserve texture details and color information from the visible images, while also losing structural edge features of the high-voltage transmission tower, thereby reducing the overall visual quality and scene representation capability of the fused results. In contrast, SeeRF achieves a better balance among texture details, color information, and infrared thermal radiation features during the fusion process, producing high-quality fusion results with clear structures, natural colors, and prominent thermal target information.
blocks.zh: 图像融合的定性结果 : 图7列出了相应的定性可视化结果。 首先,SeeRF能够产生更完整和自然的被熔化的场景. 由于红外和可见传感器之间的视场相差,所注册图像中的某些目标区域可能仅以一种方式出现,这导致现有方法在聚变过程中出现信息丢失,结构不连续和不自然的视觉过渡. 例如,在第一幕中,紫色盒子内行人的部分红外线信息缺失. 由于大多数相竞方法缺乏有效的基因完成能力,它们往往会产生明显的片面缺失文物. 同样,在涉及车辆废气管、轮胎、路面、把手棒和脚等结构的非重叠视野区域,现有方法难以适当模拟跨模式视野关系,往往造成结构缺失和聚变文物。 相比之下,SeeRF通过将准确的跨模式登记战略与基于扩散的基因聚变机制相结合,可以有效地从非重叠视野地区学习和取回信息. 因此,它恢复了更完整的目标结构,同时保持了空间上的一致性,从而产生了更自然,更连续,更能视觉上一致的被保险的结果. 第二,SeeRF可以产生更清晰的视觉表现,同时有效地保存关键结构和来源图像的详细信息. 在第一场景的栅栏区和第三场景的高压传输塔区,大多数对比方法都未能从可见图像中充分保存出纹理细节和颜色信息,同时也失去了高压传输塔的结构边缘特征,从而降低了被熔接结果的整体视觉质量和场景表现能力. 相形之下,SeeRF在聚变过程中在纹理细节,色相信息和红外热辐射特征之间实现了更好的平衡,产生了具有清晰结构,自然颜色,显著热靶信息的高质量聚变结果.

blocks.en: Quantitative Results on Image Fusion: The quantitative results are summarized in Tab. II . The experimental results demonstrate that SeeRF achieves superior overall performance across multiple image fusion evaluation metrics, validating its effectiveness and robustness under diverse scenes and complex environments. On the MFNet dataset, SeeRF obtains the best performance on four metrics, including SD, VIF, CC, and Q A ​ B / F Q^{AB/F} , while maintaining competitive performance in terms of SSIM. Compared with the overall second-best performing method, Reg. +U2Fusion, SeeRF achieves improvements of 1.8385, 0.1962, 0.0398, and 0.1154 in SD, VIF, CC, and Q A ​ B / F Q^{AB/F} , respectively. These results demonstrate that the proposed method can better preserve salient information from the source images while enhancing the structural consistency and visual quality of the fused results. On the FMB dataset, the proposed SeeRF achieves the best overall performance, obtaining the optimal results on VIF, CC, and Q A ​ B / F Q^{AB/F} , while maintaining competitive performance on SD and SSIM. Furthermore, on the LLVIP dataset, SeeRF ranks first across all evaluation metrics, demonstrating stable and consistent performance advantages. These results comprehensively validate the superior capability of SeeRF in enhancing fused-image contrast, preserving visual information fidelity, retaining salient information from source images, and maintaining structural consistency. They further demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method across diverse infrared–visible image fusion scenarios.

blocks.en: Semantic Segmentation: For the semantic segmentation task, we adopt SegFormer-B2 [ 47 ] as the backbone network and conduct experiments on the MFNet and FMB datasets. The qualitative and quantitative experimental results are presented in Figs. 8 – 9 and Tabs. III – IV .

blocks.en: From the perspective of qualitative analysis, SeeRF demonstrates superior segmentation accuracy and stronger capability in preserving complete target structures in downstream semantic segmentation tasks. In contrast, due to the limitations of existing methods, competing methods are prone to target region missing, boundary misclassification, and incorrect category predictions, thereby reducing the ability of fused results to represent high-level semantic information.
blocks.zh: 从定性分析的角度来看,SeeRF显示在下游语义分解任务中保存完整目标结构的精度和更强的能力. 相形之下,由于现有方法的局限性,相竞方法容易被目标区域所缺少,边界分类错误,分类预测不正确,从而降低了被保险结果代表高层次语义信息的能力.

blocks.en: From the quantitative evaluation results, SeeRF achieves the best mIoU performance on both the FMB and MFNet datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness for downstream semantic segmentation tasks. These results suggest that, benefiting from more accurate cross-modal alignment, effective information integration, and the capability to complete non-overlapping field-of-view regions, SeeRF is able to produce fused representations with richer semantic information and stronger consistency, thereby further enhancing semantic segmentation performance.
blocks.zh: 从定量评价结果来看,SeeRF在FMB和最惠国数据集上都取得了最好的MIOU性能,证明了它对下游语义分解任务的有效性. 这些结果表明,SeeRF得益于更准确的跨模式组合、有效的信息整合以及完成非重叠视野区域的能力,因此能够产生具有更丰富的语义信息和更强一致性的组合表述,从而进一步提高语义分化性能。

blocks.en: Object Detection: For the object detection task, we employ YOLOv11 1 1 1 https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics as the evaluation backbone and initialize it with pretrained weights. For the fused images produced by each image fusion method, the object detector is retrained on the corresponding datasets to ensure a fair comparison. The qualitative and quantitative results are presented in Fig. 10 and Tab. V , respectively. From a qualitative perspective, constrained by limited viewpoint alignment and field-of-view correspondence capabilities, almost all competing methods suffer from missed detections. Moreover, U2Fusion, MURF, and SuperFusion produce duplicate detections and false positives in some sets of results. In contrast, the proposed method achieves the most comprehensive detection performance, demonstrating superior scene representation capability. From a quantitative perspective, the proposed SeeRF consistently achieves the best performance across all evaluation metrics, including Precision, Recall, mAP@50, and mAP@50:95. Compared with the second-best performing method, U2Fusion, SeeRF obtains improvements of 0.038, 0.031, 0.057, and 0.054 in Precision, Recall, mAP@50, and mAP@50:95, respectively. These results clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in facilitating downstream semantic segmentation tasks.

blocks.en: General Experiments: To comprehensively validate the effectiveness of each proposed component, we conduct a series of ablation studies and systematically analyze the contribution of individual components from both image registration and image fusion perspectives. For the MIR, we conduct ablation experiments by removing the foundation model (DINOv3) Guidance mechanism (w/o FMG), replacing the proposed diffeomorphic deformation generation strategy with a conventional random elastic deformation generation method (w/o DGS), and substituting the coarse-to-fine progressive flow regression strategy with direct flow prediction (w/o CTF). For the MCF, we individually remove the control residual feature encoder (w/o CRFE), the cross-modal control encoding module (w/o CCE), and the valid field-of-view mask mechanism (w/o VFM). By ablating the valid field-of-view mask (VFM), we disable the guidance for generative completion, enabling a controlled comparison to evaluate the effect of out-of-field content generation. These experiments aim to systematically investigate the contribution of each component to registration accuracy and fusion quality. The results are presented in Fig. 11 and Tab. VI .

blocks.en: From the perspective of image registration performance, removing any individual component leads to degradation in the final registration results. Specifically, qualitative comparisons show that variants without specific modules tend to exhibit larger spatial offsets, edge misalignment, and structural inconsistencies. Quantitative evaluations further reveal increased in EPE and MAE, accompanied by noticeable declines in MI, CC, and SSIM between the registered and reference images. These results demonstrate the necessity of each proposed component for accurate displacement field modeling, effective cross-modal structural alignment, and improved registration quality.
blocks.zh: 从图像登记业绩的角度来看,删除任何单个组成部分会导致最终登记结果的退化。 具体来说,质的比较表明,没有特定模块的变体往往表现出较大的空间相抵,边缘错位和结构上不一致. 定量评价进一步显示,在教育、环境和环境方面,教育、环境和环境评估有所增加,同时,在登记和参考图像之间,管理、CC和SSIM明显下降。 这些结果表明,每个拟议组成部分都需要准确的流离失所实地模型、有效的跨模式结构调整以及提高登记质量。

blocks.en: From the perspective of joint image registration and fusion, qualitative results demonstrate that removing CRFE leads to noticeable structural distortions and loss of fine-grained details in the fused scenes. Without CCE, the weakened cross-modal guidance injection capability results in unnatural color transitions and insufficient information integration. Meanwhile, after removing VFM and preventing the diffusion model from generating content in non-overlapping field-of-view regions, we observe a significant degradation in fusion quality outside the shared field of view, with the overall results exhibiting unnatural discontinuities and incomplete scene representations. Quantitative evaluations further show that, except for the SD metric, the complete model achieves the best performance across all other evaluation metrics. These results further validate the critical contributions of the proposed components in improving fusion quality and enhancing the generative capability of the framework.
blocks.zh: 从联合图像登记和组合的角度来看,质量结果表明,删除通用报告格式会导致在引信场景中明显的结构扭曲和失去精细细节。 没有CCE,被削弱的跨模式制导注射能力会导致不自然的色彩过渡和信息整合不足. 与此同时,在消除了VFM和防止传播模式在非重叠视场区域产生内容后,我们看到在共同视场外的聚变质量严重退化,总体结果显示不自然的不连续性和不完整的场景表现. 定量评价还表明,除自毁计量标准外,完整的模型在所有其他评价计量标准中都取得了最佳业绩。 这些结果进一步证实了拟议组成部分在提高核聚变质量和加强框架的基因能力方面的重要贡献。

blocks.en: Semantic Experiments: To investigate the effects of individual components and out-of-field content generation on downstream semantic segmentation performance, we train all model variants on the MFNet dataset under the same experimental settings as those used in the semantic segmentation task. The corresponding qualitative and quantitative results are presented in Fig. 12 and Tab. VII , respectively.

blocks.en: From the qualitative results, the absence of modality-specific information in non-overlapping field-of-view regions and the resulting unnatural fusion discontinuities negatively affect the completeness of scene semantic representation. Specifically, the bump target within the red box exhibits obvious structural truncation in the segmentation results, failing to preserve its complete semantic contour. Meanwhile, the corresponding fusion visualization also exhibits poor visual continuity and representation quality. These observations indicate that information loss caused by field-of-view inconsistency not only degrades the visual quality of fused images but also compromises the structural integrity of objects, thereby affecting the accurate recognition and complete representation of targets in downstream semantic segmentation tasks. Similarly, removing either CRFE or CCE impairs the model’s ability to capture fine-grained features and effectively integrate multimodal information, consequently degrading its performance on downstream semantic segmentation tasks. These findings further substantiate the motivation behind our approach and demonstrate the important contributions of CRFE and CCE to improving fusion quality and enhancing semantic representation for downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 从质量结果来看,在非重叠视野区域缺乏特定模式的信息以及由此产生的非自然聚变不连续对场景语义表述的完整性产生了不利影响。 具体来说,红盒内的凸起目标在分解结果中显示出明显的结构折断,未能保持其完整的语义轮廓. 同时,相应的聚变可视化也显示出视觉连续性和表现质量不佳. 这些意见表明,视场不一致造成的信息损失不仅会降低被引信的图像的视觉质量,而且会损害物体的结构完整性,从而影响下游语义分解任务中目标准确识别和完全表现. 同样地,删除通用报告格式或CCE会损害模型捕捉精细特征并有效整合多式信息的能力,从而降低其在下游语义分解任务上的性能。 这些结论进一步证实了我们的方法背后的动机,并表明通用报告格式和欧委会对提高聚变质量和加强下游任务的语义代表性的重要贡献。

blocks.en: The quantitative results show that disabling content generation beyond the shared field of view leads to a distinct decrease in segmentation mIoU, highlighting the importance of generative completion in addressing field-of-view limitations. Similarly, removing either CRFE or CCE results in degraded semantic segmentation performance, further demonstrating the contributions of these modules to downstream task effectiveness. Overall, the proposed SeeRF achieves the best performance, consistently outperforming all ablation variants by clear margins.

blocks.en: IV-D Generative Credibility Analysis Experiment
blocks.zh: IV-D 遗传可信性分析实验

blocks.en: To evaluate the feasibility of full-field-of-view image fusion, we independently assess the similarity between the generated content in non-overlapping field-of-view regions and the corresponding ground-truth images from the original modalities. Given the nature of this similarity assessment task, we adopt evaluation metrics similar to those used for image registration and additionally include peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) to quantify the fidelity of the generated content. In the setting where infrared information is missing, poor metric values indicate that the generated regions either lack meaningful infrared information or fail to faithfully represent the actual infrared scene. Conversely, stronger similarity between the generated content and the ground-truth scene corresponds to better metric performance. Accordingly, higher MI, CC, PSNR, and SSIM values indicate more reliable and accurate generation, whereas a lower MAE indicates smaller reconstruction errors and better generation quality.
blocks.zh: 为了评价全景场图像融合的可行性,我们独立地评估非重叠视野区域生成的内容与原模式中相应的地情图像之间的相似性。 鉴于这种相似性评估任务的性质,我们采用类似于图像登记所用的评价衡量标准,并增加峰值信号-噪音比(PSNR),以量化生成内容的忠诚性。 在红外线信息缺失的环境下,差的计量值表明所生成的区域要么缺乏有意义的红外线信息,要么无法忠实地代表实际红外线场景. 反之,生成的内容与地面真实场景之间更紧密的相近性与衡量性能更佳相对应. 因此,较高的MI、CC、PSNR和SSIM值表明生成更加可靠和准确,而较低的MAE则表明重建错误较小,生成质量更好。

blocks.en: Building on this, we disable content generation in non-overlapping field-of-view regions (w/o GEN.) by controlling the VFM. Subsequently, we compare the generated content and the non-generative baseline against the corresponding ground-truth regions of the other modality to evaluate the reliability of the generated information. The quantitative experimental results are reported in Tab. VIII . The results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms the non-generative variant across all quantitative evaluation metrics. This indicates that SeeRF can generate content that is more consistent with the actual scene, thereby effectively improving information representation in non-overlapping field-of-view regions.

blocks.en: IV-E Real-World Validation Experiment
blocks.zh: IV-E 真实世界验证实验

blocks.en: To further validate the effectiveness of the proposed method in practical scenarios, we collected real-world data using the multispectral imaging equipment of a DJI Mavic 3T and conducted experiments on the acquired dataset. The corresponding experimental results are presented in Fig. 13 .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步验证拟议方法在实际情景中的有效性,我们利用DJI Mavic 3T的多光谱成像设备收集了现实世界数据,并对获得的数据集进行了实验。 相应的实验结果参见图13.

blocks.en: In real-world scenarios, existing methods exhibit two major limitations. (1) Limited registration capability. Some competing methods struggle to establish accurate cross-modal correspondences, leaving substantial spatial misalignment in the registered results and failing to adequately compensate for target displacements caused by temporal offsets between sensor acquisitions. Specifically, FusionReg and MulFS-CAP fail to achieve effective spatial alignment across all presented scenes, exhibiting pronounced registration failures. CPMFusion, SuperFusion, and AUNet achieve partial improvements in cross-modal alignment; however, noticeable stretching and geometric distortions persist near image boundaries, compromising the overall visual quality of the fused results. Among the competing methods, CrossRAFT, denoted as Reg. , demonstrates relatively strong registration performance, achieving reasonable spatial alignment in most scenes, although noticeable misalignment remains in certain boundary regions. By comparison, SeeRF achieves more accurate alignment of both target regions and image boundaries, substantially reducing local misalignment and implausible geometric distortions, thereby delivering superior overall registration performance. (2) Field-of-view inconsistency. All competing methods fail to effectively recover missing information in non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Notably, the limitations imposed by field-of-view discrepancies become even more apparent when accurate spatial alignment has been achieved. Although some methods successfully align the overlapping regions, they fail to adequately recover targets, such as pedestrians and vehicles, located in non-overlapping regions. Consequently, the fused images exhibit pronounced structural discontinuities and unnatural transitions between observed and missing regions. These artifacts compromise the integrity of target-level semantic structures and reduce overall scene fidelity, ultimately limiting the representational capacity of the fused images. In contrast, by leveraging the powerful prior modeling and content completion capabilities of generative diffusion models, SeeRF effectively reconstructs missing content in non-overlapping field-of-view regions and seamlessly integrates the generated content with the observed regions. This enables the generation of more complete and coherent fused images with improved scene representation capability.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界中,现有方法有两大局限性。 (1) 登记能力有限。 一些相互竞争的方法难以建立准确的跨模式通信,致使登记结果在空间上出现严重错位,无法充分补偿传感器购置之间时间相抵造成的目标转移。 具体而言,FusionReg和MulFS-CAP未能在所有呈现的场景中实现有效的空间相接,显示出明显的注册失败. CPMFusion、SuperFusion和AUNet在跨模式对接方面实现了部分改进;然而,显著的伸缩和几何扭曲在图像边界附近持续存在,损害了引信结果的整体视觉质量。 在相互竞争的方法中,CrossRAFT(称为Reg.)显示出相对强大的注册性能,在大多数场景中实现了合理的空间相接,尽管在某些边境地区仍然存在明显的错配. 相较之下,SeeRF实现了目标区域和图像边界的更精确的对接,大大减少了局部错配和不可信的几何扭曲,从而提供了优异的整体注册性能. (2)视野不一致。 所有相互竞争的方法都未能在非重叠的视野区域有效恢复所缺失的信息。 值得注意的是,当实现准确的空间对接时,视野差异造成的限制就变得更加明显了。 虽然有些方法成功地协调了重叠区域,但未能充分恢复位于非重叠区域的行人和车辆等目标。 因此,被接合的图像显示出明显的结构不连续,在观测到的区域和缺失的区域之间发生了非自然的过渡。 这些文物会损害目标层次语义结构的完整性并降低整体场景的忠诚度,最终会限制被引信的图像的表达能力. 与此相反,SeeRF通过利用基因传播模型先前强大的模型和内容完成能力,有效地重建了非重叠视野区域缺失的内容,并将生成的内容与被观测区域无缝地融合. 这使得能够生成更完整、更连贯的、具有更好的场景显示能力的图像。

blocks.en: IV-F Computational Overhead
blocks.zh: 四-F 计算 间接费用

blocks.en: To evaluate the computational efficiency of the proposed method, we report the number of model parameters, computational complexity (FLOPs), and inference time. Since our fusion process is built upon a diffusion model, we further decompose the entire framework into individual components and analyze their detailed parameter counts and computational costs, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the resource consumption of each module. The results are reported in Tab. IX . It can be observed that, for the MIR registration component (SeeRF-Reg.), although a visual foundation model is incorporated, the overall computational cost remains acceptable, with 113.367M parameters, 437.667G FLOPs, and an inference time of 0.142s. For the MCF fusion component (SeeRF-Fus.), the overall network is built upon the diffusion model. To preserve strong generative capability, it inevitably introduces higher computational costs, with 1701.765M parameters, 1968.819G FLOPs, and an inference time of 5.293s.

blocks.en: V Limitation
blocks.zh: 五 限制

blocks.en: To achieve superior registration and fusion performance, we incorporate visual foundation models with strong representation capabilities and diffusion models as the backbone components of our framework. Although these models substantially improve task performance, they inevitably introduce increased computational complexity and inference overhead. Despite employing sampling acceleration strategies to alleviate the computational burden during inference, the proposed architecture still leaves room for further lightweighting and optimization. Future research may explore more efficient generative paradigms, such as single-step generation or flow matching, to reduce computational and memory requirements while preserving the effectiveness of the proposed framework, thereby facilitating its deployment in real-world applications.
blocks.zh: 为了实现更好的登记和聚变性能,我们采用了具有强大代表性的视觉基础模型和传播模型,作为我们框架的骨干组成部分。 虽然这些模型大大提高了任务性能,但不可避免地增加了计算的复杂性并增加了推论费。 尽管在推论中采用了采样加速策略来减轻计算负担,但拟议的建筑仍留有进一步减轻和优化的余地. 未来的研究可能探索更有效的基因模式,如单步生成或流量匹配,以减少计算和内存要求,同时保持拟议框架的有效性,从而促进其在现实世界应用中的应用.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a generative registration and fusion framework, termed SeeRF, which aims to overcome the long-standing limitation of shared fields of view in image fusion. It addresses the long-standing issue in image registration and fusion, where existing methods primarily rely on information alignment and fusion within overlapping shared field-of-view regions while neglecting the complementary information contained in sensor-specific regions, resulting in missing information or residual artifacts in non-shared field-of-view regions. Specifically, SeeRF first performs flow field estimation and generates valid field-of-view masks through a diffeomorphic stationary velocity field-based deformation generation strategy, combined with a vision foundation model-guided feature extraction mechanism and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module. Subsequently, the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion is tightly coupled with the multi-modal image registration module, leveraging powerful generative capabilities to overcome the shared field-of-view constraint and achieve effective modeling and fusion of non-shared field-of-view information. Extensive experiments on public datasets and real-world data demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.
